title: VTP Pruning Stripping VLAN 50 Across Distribution Trunk
original_ai_root_cause: AI Initial Diagnosis: VTP domain name is mismatched between switches or VTP password was typed incorrectly, preventing VLAN 50 database propagation.
corrected_root_cause: VTP Pruning is enabled globally and dynamically pruned VLAN 50 from trunk Gi0/1 because SW-Access2 did not have an active access port in VLAN 50. The VTP domain and revision are actually fine.
reason_ai_was_wrong: AI MISDIAGNOSIS (Responsible AI): AI claimed VTP domain name mismatch. The show vtp status clearly confirms VTP Server with domain CAMPUS is working normally. The actual root cause is dynamic VTP Pruning on the trunk.

title: HSRP Split Brain — ACL Blocking UDP 1985 Hellos
original_ai_root_cause: AI Initial Diagnosis: HSRP Group number mismatch between R1 and R2 or HSRP priority conflict.
corrected_root_cause: Extended ACL 100 applied inbound on R2 Gi0/0.10 lacks a permit rule for HSRP multicast traffic (UDP port 1985 to 224.0.0.2 / 224.0.0.102). R2 never hears R1 hellos and enters Active state.
reason_ai_was_wrong: AI MISDIAGNOSIS (Responsible AI): AI guessed HSRP group mismatch, failing to correlate the ACL 100 deny matches on the interface. Adding UDP 1985 permit statement immediately resolved the dual-active state.

title: Missing IP Helper-Address for Remote DHCP Relay
original_ai_root_cause: AI Initial Diagnosis: Central DHCP server service has stopped or firewall is blocking UDP port 67/68 across the WAN.
corrected_root_cause: Router R1 subinterface Gi0/0.30 lacks "ip helper-address 10.0.0.5". Client broadcast DISCOVER packets are dropped at the router rather than being unicast forwarded to the DHCP server.
reason_ai_was_wrong: AI REJECTION (Responsible AI): AI hallucinated server crash and WAN firewall blocks. The running config clearly shows Gi0/0.30 has no ip helper-address configured.

title: Static Route Missing — Branch Cannot Reach HQ Subnet
original_ai_root_cause: AI Initial Diagnosis: Static route for 10.1.0.0/24 is missing on R2. Default route forwards private packets to ISP.
corrected_root_cause: Static route for 10.1.0.0/24 is missing on R2, AND return route for 10.2.0.0/24 is missing on HQ router R1. Routing must be bidirectional.
reason_ai_was_wrong: AI MISDIAGNOSIS (Responsible AI): AI identified only the forward route on R2 and missed the return route on R1. Both routes are strictly necessary for end-to-end communication.

title: OSPF Stuck in EXSTART/EXCHANGE State (MTU Mismatch)
original_ai_root_cause: AI Initial Diagnosis: OSPF Network Type mismatch (Broadcast vs Point-to-Point) causing DR/BDR election conflict.
corrected_root_cause: MTU mismatch between R1 (MTU 1500) and R2 (MTU 1400). OSPF DBD packets larger than 1400 bytes are dropped by R2, locking the adjacency in EXSTART/EXCHANGE state.
reason_ai_was_wrong: AI REJECTION (Responsible AI): AI mistakenly diagnosed OSPF Network Type mismatch. An EXSTART stuck state is the textbook symptom of MTU mismatch during DBD packet exchange.

title: BGP Route Not Advertised — Network Mask Mismatch
original_ai_root_cause: AI Initial Diagnosis: BGP neighbor session needs a soft reset (clear ip bgp * soft) to trigger outbound route refresh.
corrected_root_cause: BGP network statement specifies classful /8 mask (255.0.0.0), but the routing table (RIB) contains an exact /24 (255.255.255.0). BGP strictly requires an exact match of prefix AND mask in the RIB to originate a route.
reason_ai_was_wrong: AI MISDIAGNOSIS (Responsible AI): AI recommended clearing BGP sessions. The fundamental issue is that BGP will never originate a route if the network statement mask does not match the RIB entry.

title: Standard ACL Placed Near Source Blocking All Outbound Traffic
original_ai_root_cause: AI Initial Diagnosis: ACL 1 rule order is incorrect or needs a permit statement added.
corrected_root_cause: Standard ACLs evaluate SOURCE address only. Applying Standard ACL 1 on the source gateway interface Gi0/0 filters ALL outbound traffic from 192.168.10.5. Filtering a specific destination requires an Extended ACL placed near the source.
reason_ai_was_wrong: AI MISDIAGNOSIS (Responsible AI): AI suggested "permit any" in the standard ACL which would unblock everything. Cisco rule: Standard ACLs must be placed near destination; to filter source-to-destination traffic at the source interface, an Extended ACL is required.

title: Wireless Client Cannot Obtain IP via DHCP (AP Port in Default VLAN)
original_ai_root_cause: AI Initial Diagnosis: Switchport Fa0/10 is in access mode VLAN 1 and should be changed to access VLAN 40.
corrected_root_cause: The Access Point broadcasts multiple SSIDs (CorpWiFi on VLAN 40 and GuestWiFi on VLAN 50). The switchport Fa0/10 must be configured as an 802.1Q TRUNK port carrying VLANs 40 and 50 (with native VLAN for AP management), rather than a single access port.
reason_ai_was_wrong: AI MISDIAGNOSIS (Responsible AI): AI recommended setting Fa0/10 to access VLAN 40. However, because the AP serves multiple SSIDs (Corp and Guest), it requires an 802.1Q trunk port.
